tagline: Lightweight internal web app to browse and maintain company profiles
short_description: Company Hub is a self-contained internal web app for browsing, viewing, and editing company information, managing locations, references, news, logos, and generating PDF summaries.
long_description: Company Hub is a simple internal web app for a small, globally distributed firm to view and maintain information about the companies it works with, intended as a lightweight backbone for other internal workflows rather than a full CRM. Structured company data lives in a relational database while files and generated artifacts are handled through a simple object-storage capability, and it can generate a clean one-page PDF summary of a company profile. The backend is FastAPI on SQLite via async SQLAlchemy 2.0 with versioned Alembic migrations, serving a static client-side Bootstrap SPA with no build step. Authentication uses fastapi-users with cookie-based sessions, role-based access levels (guest, read-only, user, admin), admin user management, and optional config-driven Google SSO. It ships with OpenCode automation tools and agents that call the same authenticated API, plus Docker/Docker Compose for running the stack.
